response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (15+ years) with deep TypeScript/Node.js/React expertise, direct experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB/MySQL, and hands-on AI-agent tooling (MCP frameworks), closely matching the role's primary stack and required skills. His long track record across many languages and domains signals strong architecture and problem-solving ability, though explicit NestJS, Kotlin, and named testing framework (Jest/Vitest/Playwright) experience are not clearly stated in the resume.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (15+ years) exceeding the 6+ year requirement, with strong TypeScript/Node.js/React background
Direct recent experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, a specifically required skill
Broad multi-language and multi-platform expertise (Java, C#, DLang, Swift) demonstrating strong engineering versatility and adaptability
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Kotlin, both listed as primary/secondary stack requirements
No clear evidence of Jest/Vitest/Playwright usage, though he built custom testing tools (Trial, Fluent-Asserts) in D
PostgreSQL not mentioned; database experience leans toward MongoDB/MySQL rather than the named relational DB
